rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Checks that broad working-age cohorts (20-64, 25-54, 55-64) have observations up to at least 2025.

params.query: SELECT * FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_Person_20To64Years', 'Count_Person_25To54Years', 'Count_Person_55To64Years')

rules.description: Checks that standard demographic cohorts have observations up to at least 2023.

params.query: SELECT * FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Count_Person_20To64Years', 'Count_Person_25To54Years', 'Count_Person_55To64Years')
